description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Founding Forward Deployed Engineer, you will connect an AI-powered operations platform with customers' day-to-day workflows in the consumer packaged goods sector. You will own implementations from initial discovery through go-live, helping customers improve how they manage wholesale operations while bringing field insights back to the product team.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead customer onboarding end to end, including discovery, integration, configuration, testing, and go-live.

 - Work directly with operations teams to map purchase-order-to-cash workflows and configure the platform to meet their needs.

 - Build and troubleshoot integrations involving EDI, ERP, inventory, accounting, and freight systems.

 - Turn complex operational requirements into clear data models, configurations, and product capabilities.

 - Share customer insights with engineering and help shape product improvements.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of experience in forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, implementation engineering, technical onboarding, or a similar customer-facing technical role.

 - Experience owning customer onboarding from discovery through integration, configuration, testing, and launch.

 - Strong working knowledge of APIs, data models, SQL, and integration debugging, with the ability to read and write code.

 - Hands-on experience integrating EDI, ERP, inventory, accounting, and freight systems.

 - Experience mapping purchase-order-to-cash workflows and translating operational needs into technical configurations.

 - CPG, supply chain, logistics, or ERP experience is a plus. Comfort with ambiguity, changing needs, and hands-on customer problem solving is important.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.


LOCATION

This is an on-site role based in New York, United States.
